name: rout-bound-defender
description: A defender whose combined force is almost all naval -- 100 naval at 20,000 personnel each, plus 2,000 infantry -- attacked by a naval force. `chooseDefendingUnitTypeIndex()` engages its own type first, so the attacker destroys the naval and leaves the infantry alive: the defender's COMBINED FORCE collapses below the 5% rout threshold while it still has units on the field. That is a rout, and it is what makes audit 5.1 E assertable end to end instead of hoping the live map produces one. Attrition alone cannot reach the band -- an attacker big enough to win takes the defender from ~13% of its starting force to zero in one step.
